stories.title: Who’s in control of Japanese monetary policy? Tokyo or Washington?

en.title: Who's in control of Japanese monetary policy? Tokyo or Washington?
en.summary: US Treasury intervention in Japan's currency market on July 31 coincided with a dramatic shift in expectations for Bank of Japan interest rate decisions. Market probabilities for a rate increase at the September 17-18 policy meeting rose from below 30 percent to nearly 100 percent following the joint US-Japan support for the yen.
